# Edward Scissorhands Barber Shop

> Melbourne barber shop established in 1991, with two shops: St Kilda (190 Carlisle St) and South Melbourne (Clarendon Centre, Shop 11, 261 Clarendon St). Men's and boys' haircuts, fades, scissor cuts, beard trims and hot-towel shaves. Open 7 days. Walk-ins welcome; bookings are seen first.

Website: https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/
Email: info@scissorhands.com.au

## St Kilda shop
- Business: Edward Scissorhands Pty Ltd, ABN 37 415 825 760
- Address: 190 Carlisle St, St Kilda VIC 3182 (corner of Carlisle & Chapel St, near Balaclava station)
- Phone: 0485 071 024
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–7pm, Sat–Sun 9am–5pm
- Serves: St Kilda, Balaclava, Elwood, St Kilda East, Windsor, Ripponlea
- Book online: https://www.fresha.com/a/edward-scissorhands-balaclava-st-kilda-barber-melbourne-190-carlisle-street-g3vzbzld
- Google reviews: https://g.page/r/CfLTv8yacJbXEBM/review
- Page: https://edwardscissorhandsbarber.com.au/st-kilda/

### St Kilda prices (AUD, October 2026)
- Standard haircut: from $46 (prices vary by barber, day of the week and payment method; cash discount on weekdays)
- Skin fade: $58
- Scissor cut: $55
- Buzz cut: $29
- Boys' cut (under 14): $40
- Beard trim / line-up: from $30
- Hot-towel razor shave: $55
